info.title: InvestAir Data API
info.description: Subscriber access to InvestAir's proprietary ASX market intelligence via the Model Context Protocol. Connect any MCP-compatible AI client and query cash runway, capital raises, substantial holders, announcements and peer analysis in natural language.

get,post.description: The InvestAir MCP endpoint. Add this server to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP-compatible client, authenticating with your subscription key in the `authorization` request header as `Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`. See the Connect page for step-by-step setup instructions.
